events.title: Strapi open sourced
events.summary: Pierre Burgy, Aurélien Georget, and Jim Laurie published Strapi on GitHub in October 2015 — a self-hosted Node.js headless CMS.
events.about: Strapi gives developers a customizable admin UI and auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs for any content type — self-hosted unlike Contentful. It became the default open-source headless CMS for JavaScript teams building Next.js and React sites.

narrative.whyChosen: Strapi brought open-source, self-hosted headless CMS to the Node.js ecosystem.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved teams could own their content API without SaaS lock-in.
narrative.problemSolved: JavaScript developers needed a CMS that fit modern frontends, not WordPress templates.

sources.title: Strapi Handbook — Strapi Story (October 2015 GitHub publication)
